title: Grade 6 French — Mon, May 25
description: La famille (Family Members) — Day 1 of 5: Vocabulary
subject: french

questions.question: What is 'mother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mère' = mother. Core family: père(father), mère(mother), frère(brother), sœur(sister).

questions.question: How do you say 'brother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Frère' = brother. 'Sœur' = sister. Note the cedilla in 'sœur' — this is a special character.

questions.question: What does 'les enfants' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Les enfants' = the children. 'Enfant' = child (masculine or feminine). Singular: 'un enfant' (boy) or 'une enfant' (girl).

questions.question: 'J'ai deux sœurs.' What does this mean?
questions.explanation: 'Sœur' (f) = sister. 'Deux sœurs' = two sisters. Note the plural of sœur is sœurs (just add s).

questions.question: What is the French word for 'parents' (mother and father)?
questions.explanation: 'Les parents' = the parents (mother and father). Be careful: 'parents' in French can also mean 'relatives' in a broader sense.

questions.question: How do you say 'my family' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Ma famille' = my family. 'Famille' is feminine, so use 'ma' (feminine possessive): ma famille.

questions.question: What does 'fils' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Fils' = son. 'Fille' = daughter. Pronunciation: 'fils' sounds like 'feess'. Don't confuse 'fille' (daughter) with 'la fille' (the girl).

questions.question: What is the female equivalent of 'cousin'?
questions.explanation: 'Cousin' (m) → 'Cousine' (f). Many family words have masculine/feminine pairs: neveu/nièce, oncle/tante, frère/sœur.

questions.question: How do you introduce your sister in French: 'This is my sister'?
questions.explanation: 'Voici ma sœur' = This is my sister. 'Sœur' is feminine → use 'ma' (my, feminine). 'Voici' = here is/this is (for introductions).

questions.question: What does 'beau-père' literally mean, and what does it mean in context?
questions.explanation: 'Beau-père' = stepfather OR father-in-law. 'Belle-mère' = stepmother or mother-in-law. 'Beau/belle' means 'step-' or 'in-law' in family vocabulary.

questions.question: How do you say 'I have one brother and one sister'?
options: J'ai un frère et une sœur.
J'ai une frère et un sœur.
J'ai un frère et un sœur.
J'ai une frère et une sœur.
questions.explanation: 'Un frère' (m) and 'une sœur' (f). 'Frère' is masculine (un), 'sœur' is feminine (une). 'J'ai un frère et une sœur.'

questions.question: What is 'la famille nucléaire'?
questions.explanation: 'La famille nucléaire' = nuclear family = parents and their children living together. 'La famille élargie' = extended family.

questions.question: How would you ask 'Do you have siblings?' in French?
options: Tu as des frères et sœurs?
questions.explanation: 'Tu as des frères et sœurs?' = Do you have brothers and sisters? 'Des frères et sœurs' = siblings (literally 'some brothers and sisters').
